title: From cube-wise pointwise bounds to the Lipschitz constant c/σ on {dist(·, L) ≥ σ}
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and c₁ ≥ 0. There is c ∈ [0,∞), depending only on N and c₁, such that for every set L ⊆ ℝ^N = Eucl N and every map ψ : ℝ^N → ℝ^N satisfying (H1) for every z ∈ ℤ^N and x ∉ L with z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i, also z_i ≤ ψ(x)_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i, and (H2) for every z ∈ ℤ^N, every x ∉ L with z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i and every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 with |ψ(x′) − ψ(x)| ≤ (c₁/dist(x, L) + ε)|x′ − x| for all x′ ∉ L with z_i ≤ x′_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i and |x′ − x| < δ, the following holds: for every σ with 0 < σ ≤ 1/4, ψ is Lipschitz with constant c/σ on {x : dist(x, L) ≥ σ} (dist(x, L) = infDist x L, which is 0 when L = ∅; as in Lean, c₁/0 is read as 0 in (H2), a case never used in the proof).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (c₁ : ℝ), 0 ≤ c₁ → ∃ c : ℝ≥0, ∀ (L : Set (Eucl N)) (ψ : Eucl N → Eucl N), (∀ (z : Fin N → ℤ) (x : Eucl N), x ∉ L → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ ψ x i ∧ ψ x i ≤ z i + 1) → (∀ (z : Fin N → ℤ) (x : Eucl N), x ∉ L → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl N, x' ∉ L → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ z i + 1) → dist x' x < δ → dist (ψ x') (ψ x) ≤ (c₁ / infDist x L + ε) * dist x' x) → ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ 1 / 4 → LipschitzOnWith (c / Real.toNNReal σ) ψ {x | σ ≤ infDist x L}
